title: com.pqt.stock.level data
description: Stock on hand as the billing system reports it (X1, B1). Allow-listed fields only: no customer identity, card numbers or free text (ADR-033).

sku.description: The billing system's item code (business data, not personal).

qtyMilli.description: Quantity on hand in thousandths of `unit`; billing systems can report negative stock.

source.description: Which billing system reported it: tally, zoho, file, sim, ...
